meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 代码审查时，Claude 把每条评论压成一行“行号: 问题. 修复.”，用表情标严重度（🔴bug/🟡risk/🔵nit/❓q），省略客套话和重复描述。安全类问题、架构分歧或新手场景改用正常段落解释后恢复极简。只出评论，不写修复、不批准/拒绝。
howto.when: 当你说出“review this PR”、“code review”等关键词，或调用 /caveman-review 时触发；审查 pull request 时也会自动触发。

say.note: Claude 会对该 PR 输出极简逐行评论

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审查这个 diff
say.note: 切换为极简模式，给出问题与修复建议

say.text: 停止 caveman-review，恢复正常审查
say.note: 退出极简模式，恢复详细评论风格

howto.what_en: During code review, Claude outputs terse comments in `L<line>: <problem>. <fix>.` format with optional severity emojis. For security/architecture/new-user cases, it explains in a paragraph first. It only comments; does not fix, approve, or lint.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'review this PR', 'code review', 'review the diff', etc., or invokes '/caveman-review'. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.text: Use caveman-review to review this diff
